proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Whether to Allow Stockholders to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, including on any appropriate topic.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote against this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Report on the Global Median Gender/Racial Pay Gap
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Susan J. Silver, Ralph L. McCaughan III and Andrea G. Reusing and others
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on median pay gaps across race and gender globally, including associated policy, reputational, competitive and operational risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting the preparation of a report on Intel's global median gender/racial pay gap

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Whether Written Policies or Unwritten Norms at the Company Reinforce Racism in Company Culture
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc., on behalf of the NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing whether written policies or unwritten norms reinforce racism in company culture, including hiring, promotion and discipline outcomes.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting the preparation of a report on whether written policies or unwritten norms at Intel reinforce racism in company culture.
